messages:
lina: Heads up — kevin (offer accepted) starts Mon 2024-06-09 remote. Needs I-9 remote; candidate is EU-based (Portugal), no US SSN yet. Background check in 'pending manual review'. Also needs laptop, VPN access, and benefits enrollment link.
maria: Thanks — can you DM address and timezone? we'll coordinate remote I-9 slot and check BG question. If no SSN we use List B docs (passport + secondary). @sam do we need any extra docs for benefits pre-enroll? 
kevin: Hi all — I'm in Lisbon (UTC+1). Passport scanned, can upload. No SSN yet. Ok with remote I-9 or local notary.
paul: IT note: we'll stage a laptop, but per policy we hold shipment until I-9 verification completes. We can do 'courier hold' at FedEx for pickup if needed. :package: 
maria: Policy reminder: remote I-9 for employees outside US uses alternative verification — People Ops must coordinate an authorized agent or remote Notary (company-approved). I'll file exception form.
kevin: Timeline is a bit tight — can the laptop be available at nearby FedEx by Mon morning? I can pick up after we finish I-9.
lina: Recruiter update: candidate prefers Tue 09:00 PT (17:00 Lisbon). Lina->maria please confirm.
maria: Ok tentative slot Tue 09:00 PT. I'll send calendar invite with Zoom + instructions. Need kevin to upload passport image and a selfie for liveness check before the call. Also confirm phone number for SMS MFA.
kevin: Uploaded passport and selfie to the portal (link). Phone +351-912-345-678.
it-bot: Device order created: #DEV-87921, macbook pro 14, ship method: hold at FedEx. ETA 2 business days.
paul: Noted. Please update order shipping address to 'FedEx Hold - 123 Ave' once Maria confirms.
sam: Benefits note: new hires have 30 days to enroll. We'll do a 20-min Benefits orientation Wed 10:00 PT (18:00 Lisbon). I'll add the link in the invite.
maria: Checklist for go-live:
```
1) Candidate completes BG intake (pending -> clear)
2) I-9 remote verification (passport + selfie)
3) IT confirms hold/shipment
4) Benefits invite + enroll link
5) Buddy assigned (engineering)
```
paul: Buddy ping — @alex_eng can you be Kevin's buddy? Short setup and access on day 1.
alex_eng: Yep happy to. I'll set up initial repo access and Slack invites.
lina: Thanks everyone. I'll close the loop with candidate. Maria will update if we need to delay laptop shipment.
maria: Closing note — if BG manual review extends past Fri, we'll move start date to Mon+1 and hold device. :calendar: 
kevin: Thanks all — appreciate the flexibility. See you Tue for the I-9.
